So R(t-s) = -(t-s). If t-s ≠ 0, then R must be 180° rotation (or reflection but not allowed). So R = 180°.

Thus the second copy is the first rotated by 180°. Then P' is the point-symmetric image of P about some center. For endpoints to join: P' endpoints are {s', t'} = {2c - s, 2c - t} where c is center.
